experiences.title: Operations & Leadership
experiences.content: I currently serve as General Manager at Home Team Network (International Sports Streaming), leading HR — hiring, onboarding and managing 30+ independent contractors — plus supply and connectivity operations. Previously, as Project Manager – Operations at Sky Mavis (2021–2024), I reported directly to the VP of Operations and collaborated with finance, HR, security, publishing and executive management: automating Jira workflows that improved performance by 50%, leading a cybersecurity training program with 95% monthly completion, and writing SOPs that cut direct internal support by 100%.

experiences.title: Automation & Engineering
experiences.content: As Automation Engineer Lead at Interlaced (2025), I built workflow automations with no-code tools like Rewst, n8n, Retool and Make — freeing 30 minutes per person per day within 60 days and increasing efficiency by 20% within 90 days. As Founding Engineer at Pythas, I designed a multi-service (microservices, serverless) architecture and shipped an internal proof of concept in 3 months. Earlier, as QA Automation Manager at Scale Coding, I wrote TDD/BDD test cases with Mocha.js, aggregated in Allure reports, to ensure robust, reliable software delivery.

experiences.title: Esports Leadership
experiences.content: In the esports industry, I've led teams and managed operations for organizations such as Isurus Studio, Predators Esports, and LVP - Liga de Videojuegos Profesional. My focus was on creating high-performing teams, improving operational efficiency, and fostering collaboration across departments to ensure seamless execution and competitive success.
